Economy · India

Market Drivers: Crude Oil, Geopolitics, and Inflation Data

Indian stock markets are expected to be influenced this week by global geopolitical developments, particularly concerning the Strait of Hormuz and crude oil prices. Analysts also point to domestic inflation data and foreign exchange reserve updates as key factors. Market participants will monitor international negotiations involving Iran and broader shifts in global geopolitics.
